correctness.rationale: The specified grounded-Laplacian trace equals twice unit-noise total variance. A quadratic flow split proves the three-terminal resistance identity. The wheel Green kernel solves its periodic recurrence, and its derivative yields the exact two-rim formula. Strict convexity of the Bose-type function proves separation monotonicity. Exact rational comparisons handle the finite boundary, and an increasing positive lower bound handles every n>=8. An extracted independent exact matrix computation corroborates 38 orbit-case identities and the lower bound, without being used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Choosing two pinned leaders to minimize noise variance is a standard and consequential control-design problem. The wheel is a natural centrality-versus-coverage family, and the theorem classifies every optimum for all sizes, with a sharp design switch from opposite rim leaders to hub-plus-rim at seven rim vertices. The strict ordering and closed objective formulas are not routine numerical point evaluations.
